title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.15359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The surge of large language model (LLM) applications on personal devices imposes massive, bursty workloads on cloud serving infrastructure. While prefill-decode disaggregation improves throughput and scalability, memory-bound decode instances often suffer from persistent load imbalance, as output lengths are unknown when requests arrive at the cloud. To address this, we propose MAPS, a Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling framework tailored for disaggregated LLM serving. MAPS performs device-assisted speculative output length prediction overlapped with cloud-side prefilling, incurring negligible latency overhead. To handle generation uncertainty, MAPS applies uncertainty-aware calibration to derive output-length upper bounds with target coverage, enabling safe scheduling decisions. translated_title: MAPS：面向大语言模型服务的内存感知预测调度框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）应用在个人设备上的激增，给云端服务基础设施带来了大规模、突发性的工作负载。尽管预填充-解码分离技术提升了吞吐量和可扩展性，但受内存限制的解码实例常常遭受持续的负载不均衡，因为当请求到达云端时，其输出长度是未知的。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MAPS，一个专为分离式LLM服务量身打造的内存感知预测调度框架。MAPS在与云端预填充重叠的同时，执行设备辅助的推测性输出长度预测，几乎不产生额外的延迟开销。为应对生成过程中的不确定性，MAPS采用不确定性感知校准方法，推导出具有目标覆盖率的输出长度上界，从而支持安全的调度决策。基于这些上界，MAPS采用分层全局-局部调度策略，以缓解解码器之间的队列堆积和解码器内部的队头阻塞问题。
tldr: MAPS通过设备辅助的输出长度预测与不确定性感知校准，结合分层全局-局部调度策略，有效解决了分离式大语言模型服务中解码实例的内存负载不均衡问题。
en_tdlr: MAPS is a memory-aware predictive scheduling framework for disaggregated LLM serving that leverages device-assisted speculative output-length prediction with uncertainty-aware calibration and hierarchical global-local scheduling to mitigate persistent load imbalance in memory-bound decode instances.
